title: UART Frame Timeline
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Serial Communication for Robotics
description: Choose a baud rate and a packet and see every byte laid out as a ten-bit frame on a time line, with the total time to send it. Then answer five timing problems with the formula bytes times 10 divided by baud. Used in Chapter 4.

educational.topic: UART framing, baud rate and transfer time
learningObjectives: Calculate the time to send a given number of bytes at a given baud rate using 8N1 framing, to within 1 percent, in five problems, with at least 4 of 5 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: See the ten-bit frames before calculating, then apply one formula to new numbers with an immediate check
keyQuestions: Why does one byte take ten bit times on the wire?
What changes when the baud rate is halved, and what stays the same?
commonMisconceptions: A byte is 8 bits on the wire
A higher baud rate sends bytes with fewer bits
Both ends can use different baud rates
assessmentOpportunities: Five typed times, one attempt each; 4 of 5 for mastery
